column1: # Manual overrides of the automatic spatiotemporal collapse of the IBD cluster hierarchy (scripts/ibd_02_cluster.R).

#   cluster_name = a name      -> everything under that node becomes ONE cluster with this name
#   cluster_name = SPLIT       -> do not collapse this node even if it passes the date/distance rule: descend into its children
